summary: A range picker with two months side by side and a list of ready-made ranges such as Last 7 days and This quarter. People click a start day and an end day, see the range fill in as they hover, and confirm with Apply. It suits reports and dashboards where an agent's results are read over a period.
use: When a report, chart or agent summary needs a start and end date.
When most people want a common range, like the last 30 days, in one click.
When a range tied to your product, such as "Since pricing launch", should sit next to the standard ones.
features: The first click sets the start, the second sets the end; clicking a day before the start, or clicking again after a full range, starts over.
While only the start is set, hovering a later day previews the range.
From and To boxes show the picked days, and a counter shows how many days the range covers.
Presets in the side list fill the range from `today`; the preset that matches the current range lights up, and its days fill in one after another.
Apply is enabled once both days are set and calls `onApply`; Clear empties the range.
`locale`, `weekStartsOn` and `format` control the month names, week start and how days read.
a11y: Arrow keys move focus a day or a week, Home and End go to the start and end of the week, and Page Up and Page Down move a month, or a year with Shift; the months follow the focus.
Only one day is a tab stop: the one the arrows reached, the end, the start, today or the first day on show.
Moving focus with the keyboard while only the start is set previews the range the same way hovering does.
Each day button has its full date as aria-label and aria-pressed on the start and end days.
Preset buttons use aria-pressed to show which one matches the range.

faq.q: How do I add a custom preset like "Since launch"?
faq.a: Spread the exported `DateRangePickerPresets` into a new array and add your own entry with a `key`, a `label` and a `range` function that takes today and returns [start, end].

faq.q: How do people get to other months?
faq.a: There are no previous and next buttons. The view moves when a preset is picked, when the keyboard focus passes the edge of the two months (Page Up and Page Down move a month), or when you set `month` yourself.

faq.q: What is the difference between `onValueChange` and `onApply`?
faq.a: `onValueChange` fires on every click, including when only the start is set and `end` is null. `onApply` fires only when the person presses Apply with both days set.
By default the left calendar shows the month before the range's end, or before today, and the right one shows the month after it. Pass `defaultMonth` or `month` to choose.
